'''Superior Dragon Armor''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Armor]] set obtained from [[Superior Dragon]]s. It is the most powerful and expensive of 8 different [[Dragon Armors|Dragon Armor]] sets. 

== Obtaining ==
=== Superior Dragon ===
'''Superior Dragon Armor''' pieces can be dropped from the [[Superior Dragon]]. One piece has a {{Green|30%}} chance to drop from the Dragon if the player meets the [[Dragon Weight]] requirement.

;Weight Requirements
*[[File:Superior Dragon Helmet.png|26px]] Helmet: 295 Dragon Weight
*[[File:Superior Dragon Chestplate.png|26px]] Chestplate: 410 Dragon Weight
*[[File:Superior Dragon Leggings.png|26px]] Leggings: 360 Dragon Weight
*[[File:Superior Dragon Boots.png|26px]] Boots: 290 Dragon Weight

{{Skill|Combat|20}} is required to be able to use this set and, if the item is a dungeon item, {{Skill|Catacombs|14}} is required to be able to use this set while in [[Dungeons]].

When the full set is worn, the player's {{Red|Combat}} stats and {{Stat|MF}} are increased by {{Green|5%}}.

== Tips ==
*A full set of {{Reforge|Renowned}} '''Superior Dragon Armor''' provides more {{stat|Magic Find}} than a full set of {{Reforge|Renowned}} {{Item|Sorrow Armor}} if the player has more than {{stat|Magic Find|416}} while having no armor equipped.

== Trivia ==
*When this armor set was [[Reforged]] to "{{ReforgeLink|Superior}}", it became "Highly Superior". This reforge is no longer obtainable.
*The eyebrows on this set are different from the other sets, giving it a more aggressive facial expression.
*Superior Dragon Helmet is the first armor piece to have 2 cosmetic skins - Shimmer and Baby.
*Combined with a level 100 [[Ender Dragon Pet]], the {{ReforgeLink|Renowned}} reforge, and {{Ench|Legion V}} on all 4 pieces with 20 nearby players, a stat boost of 47% can be obtained.
